title: Check the corrected scatter identity and its two invoices
body:
## Summary
- The corrected word `U; scatter(U S); U^{-1}` satisfies `U^{-1}(U d + U S p) = d + S p`. The checker confirms this for the shear `U = [[1, 1], [0, 1]]` on nine integer pairs.
- Three changed tetrads cost `167 + 18 = 185` scalar operations, and fourteen cost `794 + 84 = 878`. The sign scales are `6 · 3 = 18` and `6 · 14 = 84`.
- The cut ADD counts move from 176 to 181 and from 176 to 214. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan
